cond_0001.intro: This position is responsible for coordinating and implementing quality assurance functions of the processing department. This position will also assist in the internal audits and work with the compliance department resolving quality issues as they arise.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Enforcing food safety and security procedures for our facility through programs such as HACCP and GMP's. Monitoring, documenting and reporting on finished product specifications to measure compliance with company standards. Performing quality checks of raw, work in process, and finished product through inspections. Performing analysis of finished product as required. Analysis includes visual, weight, size, mix, color, etc. Conduct self-inspections of facilities. Report the finding of food quality audits and analyze issues and implement solutions to QA Lead/Food Safety Manager. Work with all departments to prepare for external audits.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High School Degree or GED
At least 1 year experience in a Quality Assurance role or equivalent
Strong skills in data collection and organization
Ability to work weekends and holidays
Must be able to read, write, understand and speak English fluently
Must be able to work in a refrigerated environment 34-37 degrees up to 75% of the time
Ability to work with diverse groups of people
Excellent organizational skills
Preferred Requirements
General understanding of food safety
Ensure that established process control procedures are followed throughout the plant
Maintain plant compliance to the HACCP and quality systems programs
Maintain daily product evaluation programs (scoring, key quality indicators, shelf life)
Communicate and cooperate with the USDA and FDA inspectors as needed
Knowledge of HACCP and GMP's

Monitoring, documenting and reporting on finished product specifications to measure compliance with company standards. Performing quality checks of raw, work in process, and finished product through inspections. Performing analysis of finished product as required. Analysis includes visual, weight, size, mix, color, etc. Conduct self-inspections of facilities. Report the finding of food quality audits and analyze issues and implement solutions to QA Lead/Food Safety Manager. Work with all departments to prepare for external audits.
cond_0055.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High School Degree or GED
At least 1 year experience in a Quality Assurance role or equivalent
Strong skills in data collection and organization
Ability to work weekends and holidays
Must be able to read, write, understand and speak English fluently
Must be able to work in a refrigerated environment 34-37 degrees up to 75% of the time
Ability to work with diverse groups of people
Excellent organizational skills
Preferred Requirements
General understanding of food safety
Ensure that established process control procedures are followed throughout the plant
Maintain plant compliance to the HACCP and quality systems programs
Maintain daily product evaluation programs (scoring, key quality indicators, shelf life)
Communicate and cooperate with the USDA and FDA inspectors as needed
Knowledge of HACCP and GMP's

cond_0116.responsibilities:
Enforce food safety and security procedures through programs such as HACCP and GMPs.
Monitor, document, and report on finished product specifications to ensure compliance with company standards.
Execute quality checks of raw, in-process, and finished product through direct inspections.
Carry out analysis of finished product as required — including visual, weight, size, mix, and color.
Conduct self-inspections of facilities.
Report findings from food quality audits, analyze issues, and drive solutions to the QA Lead/Food Safety Manager.
Lead cross-departmental preparation for external audits.

Ability to work with diverse groups of people

General understanding of food safety
Knowledge of HACCP and GMPs
Familiarity with process control procedures and plant compliance programs
Experience maintaining daily product evaluation programs (scoring, key quality indicators, shelf life)
Experience communicating with USDA and FDA inspectors
Excellent organizational skills

cond_0449.intro: This position owns the coordination and execution of quality assurance functions within the processing department. You will also lead internal audits and drive resolution of quality issues with the compliance department as they arise.
cond_0449.responsibilities:
Enforce food safety and security procedures for our facility through programs such as HACCP and GMP's.
Own monitoring, documenting, and reporting on finished product specifications to measure compliance with company standards.
Execute quality checks of raw, work in process, and finished product through inspections.
Carry out analysis of finished product as required. Analysis includes visual, weight, size, mix, color, etc.
Conduct self-inspections of facilities.
Report findings of food quality audits, analyze issues, and implement solutions to QA Lead/Food Safety Manager.
Lead cross-departmental preparation for external audits.
cond_0449.requirements: Must have High School Degree or GED. At least 1 year experience in a Quality Assurance role or equivalent. Strong skills in data collection and organization are required. Ability to work weekends and holidays. The ideal candidate will also have a general understanding of food safety. Ensure that established process control procedures are followed throughout the plant. Maintain plant compliance to the HACCP and quality systems programs. Maintain daily product evaluation programs (scoring, key quality indicators, shelf life). Communicate and cooperate with the USDA and FDA inspectors as needed. Must be able to read, write, understand and speak English fluently. Knowledge of HACCP and GMP's preferred. Must be able to work in a refrigerated environment 34-37 degrees up to 75% of the time. Ability to work with diverse groups of people. Excellent organizational skills.

cond_0559.intro: This position is responsible for coordinating and implementing quality assurance functions of the processing department. This position will also assist in the internal audits and work with the compliance department resolving quality issues as they arise.
cond_0559.responsibilities: Enforcing food safety and security procedures for our facility through programs such as HACCP and GMP's. Monitoring, documenting and reporting on finished product specifications to measure compliance with company standards. Performing quality checks of raw, work in process, and finished product through inspections. Performing analysis of finished product as required. Analysis includes visual, weight, size, mix, color, etc. Conduct self-inspections of facilities. Report the finding of food quality audits and analyze issues and implement solutions to QA Lead/Food Safety Manager. Work with all departments to prepare for external audits.
cond_0559.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High School Degree or GED
At least 1 year experience in a Quality Assurance role or equivalent
Strong skills in data collection and organization
Ability to work weekends and holidays
Must be able to read, write, understand and speak English fluently
Must be able to work in a refrigerated environment 34-37 degrees up to 75% of the time
Ability to work with diverse groups of people
Excellent organizational skills
Preferred Requirements
General understanding of food safety
Ensure that established process control procedures are followed throughout the plant
Maintain plant compliance to the HACCP and quality systems programs
Maintain daily product evaluation programs (scoring, key quality indicators, shelf life)
Communicate and cooperate with the USDA and FDA inspectors as needed
Knowledge of HACCP and GMP's

Enforce food safety and security procedures for our facility through programs such as HACCP and GMP's.
Own monitoring, documenting, and reporting on finished product specifications to measure compliance with company standards.
Execute quality checks of raw, work in process, and finished product through inspections.
Carry out analysis of finished product as required. Analysis includes visual, weight, size, mix, color, etc.
Conduct self-inspections of facilities.
Report findings of food quality audits, analyze issues, and implement solutions to QA Lead/Food Safety Manager.
Lead cross-departmental preparation for external audits.
cond_0575.requirements: Must have High School Degree or GED. At least 1 year experience in a Quality Assurance role or equivalent. Strong skills in data collection and organization are required. Ability to work weekends and holidays. The ideal candidate will also have a general understanding of food safety. Ensure that established process control procedures are followed throughout the plant. Maintain plant compliance to the HACCP and quality systems programs. Maintain daily product evaluation programs (scoring, key quality indicators, shelf life). Communicate and cooperate with the USDA and FDA inspectors as needed. Must be able to read, write, understand and speak English fluently. Knowledge of HACCP and GMP's preferred. Must be able to work in a refrigerated environment 34-37 degrees up to 75% of the time. Ability to work with diverse groups of people. Excellent organizational skills.

People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with this kind of work.
cond_0644.responsibilities: Enforcing food safety and security procedures for our facility through programs such as HACCP and GMP's. Monitoring, documenting and reporting on finished product specifications to measure compliance with company standards. Performing quality checks of raw, work in process, and finished product through inspections. Performing analysis of finished product as required. Analysis includes visual, weight, size, mix, color, etc. Conduct self-inspections of facilities. Report the finding of food quality audits and analyze issues and implement solutions to QA Lead/Food Safety Manager. Work with all departments to prepare for external audits.
cond_0644.requirements: Must have High School Degree or GED; At least 1 year experience in a Quality Assurance role or equivalent. Strong skills in data collection and organization are required. Ability to work weekends and holidays. The ideal candidate will also have a general understanding of food safety. Ensure that established process control procedures are followed throughout the plant. Maintain plant compliance to the HACCP and quality systems programs. Maintain daily product evaluation programs (scoring, key quality indicators, shelf life). Communicate and cooperate with the USDA and FDA inspectors as needed. Must be able to read, write, understand and speak English fluently. Knowledge of HACCP and GMP's preferred. Must be able to work in a refrigerated environment 34-37 degrees up to 75% of the time. Ability to work with diverse groups of people. Excellent organizational skills.
